program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((target (at g 0 0)))
    (define guide-rows (filter (lambda (r) (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 5)) (range 0 (cols g)))) (range 0 (rows g))))
    (define guide-cols (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 5)) (range 0 (rows g)))) (range 0 (cols g))))
    (define cells (filter (lambda (cell)
                            (and (= (third cell) target)
                                 (not (and (= (first cell) 0) (= (second cell) 0)))))
                          (grid-cells g)))
    (define (mirror out cell axis p)
      (let* ((r (first cell)) (c (second cell)) (v (third cell))
             (nr (if (= axis 0) r (- (* 2 p) r)))
             (nc (if (= axis 0) (- (* 2 p) c) c)))
        (if (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g)) (set-cell out nr nc v) out)))
    (cond [(not (empty? guide-cols))
           (for/fold ([out g]) ([cell (in-list cells)]) (mirror out cell 0 (first guide-cols)))]
          [(not (empty? guide-rows))
           (for/fold ([out g]) ([cell (in-list cells)]) (mirror out cell 1 (first guide-rows)))]
          [else g])))
